name: Mosaic
outlook:
What Mosaic says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: potashFourth quarter 2026 sales volumes are expected to be in the range of 2.3 to 2.6 million tonnes, with realized mine gate MOP prices in the range of $255 to $275 per tonne.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: phosphateFor the fourth quarter, sales volumes are expected to be of 1.3 to 1.6 million tonnes. DAP prices at the plant are expected to average $820 to $840 per tonne.
  • Full year 2026: potash productionAs a result, full-year potash production is now expected to be 8.6 million tonnes in 2026.
  • Capital expenditures: 2026 and 2027Capital expen ditures in 2026 are now expected to be $1.2 billion. For 2027, Mosaic is targeting capital expenditures below $1 billion.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
